entities.name: GcpE/IspG
observations: 349 aa protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed Clostridium tetani GcpE/IspG reference Q895K3.
Pfam matches: GcpE PF04551.20 at residues 6–245 and GcpE_C PF26540.1 at residues 260–348.
Predicted molecular mass is 37,989.6 Da and theoretical pI is 7.52.
Catalyzes conversion of ME-cPP to HMBPP in the MEP isoprenoid pathway.
Binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster and uses a reduced flavodoxin/ferredoxin electron donor system.

entities.name: ME-cPP to HMBPP
observations: Rhea references include RHEA:43604, RHEA:10622, and RHEA:10623.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: GcpE/IspG performs step 5 of 6 in the DXP/MEP pathway producing isopentenyl diphosphate precursors.
The pathway supplies isoprenoid and terpenoid biosynthesis.

entities.name: [4Fe-4S] cluster
observations: GcpE/IspG binds one [4Fe-4S] iron-sulfur cluster required for its reductive catalytic activity.
